author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
You don't have to run faster than the bear, you just need to run faster than your friend.
You don't have to be better than AI, you just need to adopt AI faster than your colleagues, so AI will replace them first.
They still need someone to babysit the AI, kick it and tell it to work harder every 2 hours.
